notes: Decomposition of the three-option build/property type selector. Crops are references only; final raster drawings must be newly generated assets.

assets.label: Build property type selector section
assets.role: Reusable three-row editorial selector component with live text and generated sketch assets
assets.rationale: The rows, typography, dividers, spacing, and responsive behavior should remain editable in React. The pencil drawings are referenced through separate generated image assets.

acceptance: Uses live text for property type labels and taglines
Uses generated WebP illustration assets rather than crop files
Adapts existing local shadcn Separator primitive or documents why CSS dividers are a better fit
Exports reusable data and component props for alternate row content

assets.label: Multi-plex building pencil engraving
assets.rationale: Detailed architectural pencil rendering with shrubs and trees is better generated as a transparent raster asset than recreated with code.

generation.prompt: Use the reference crop only as visual guidance. Generate a new standalone transparent-background graphite pencil and fine ink architectural illustration of a compact three-storey urban multi-plex apartment building with a small side stair volume, front shrubs, one mature tree, and light ground hatching. Editorial real-estate marketing style, grayscale linework, subtle paper-sketch texture, crisp edges, no text, no logo, no frame, no colored background.
generation.negative_prompt: Do not copy the crop exactly. No words, labels, watermark, people, cars, heavy shadows, photorealism, color fill, blueprints, or background rectangle.
